thread:
oncall-bot: pager: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/chat/completions (region: us-west-2). p99 3.2s over last 1m, baseline ~0.9s. alert: alerting/chat-completions-p99 (severity: page).
Aisha K.: acked, jumping in. viewing traces now.
Miguel: on my way — can you confirm whether KV-cache hit rate dropped?
Aisha K.: KV cache looks fine but we have a cluster of requests routed to model-legacy-quant that has higher tail. traffic split changed ~5m ago (canary).
Priya: oof that canary is the new routing policy from last week. @Miguel any chance autoscaler lagged for that pool?
Miguel: autoscaler processed, but instance spinup had a prolonged init due to docker image pull backlog on some nodes. seeing ~90s extra to pod ready for that pool.
Ken: i'm on infra, checking node provisioning logs. nodes in gw-pool-3 hit 0.8 I/O surge, pulled other images concurrently.
Aisha K.: mitigation: 1) reverted canary routing -> re-split to 90/10 legacy/canary 2) squelch p99 alert to avoid paging during mitigation (requested by oncall) 3) temporarily increase concurrency cap on model-legacy-quant pool to absorb backlog.
Lara: customer-impact note: we saw 0.25% of requests exceed 2s, but error rate didn't increase. support notified top-3 tenants (they reported slow responses).
Priya: good catch. can we failover chat/completions for heavy customers to fallback-llm-small? quality tradeoff but latency better.
Aisha K.: already did a soft fallback for the three tenants with traffic-shift: 100rps -> fallback-llm-small, monitored. latency improved to ~0.7s for their sessions.
ops-sre: thanks. creating postmortem checklist item to track image-pull saturation and node disk contention.
Miguel: for the alerting side — proposal: change p99 alert to trigger only when both: p99 > 2s AND request volume > 50rps (min-samples) for 5m. current rule is p99 > 1.5s over 1m, which is noisy for small routes.
Aisha K.: agree. also propose per-route per-model p99 rules instead of global. some low-traffic routes will keep tripping global p99.
Ken: suggest adding a traffic-weighted percentile summary to dashboard: show p95/p99 computed over top routes + overall. will help identify noisy low-volume outliers.
Lara: plus add a noise-gate: only alert if p99 delta > 30% relative to a 1h rolling median AND absolute p99 > 2s. reduces alerts for small fluctuations.
Priya: we should also switch p99 evaluation window to 5m for paging severity but keep a 1m advisory channel metric (no page) for on-call visibility.
Aisha K.: drafted alert rule (please review):
```yaml
- alert: ChatCompletionsHighP99
  expr: |
    histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model, route)) > 2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p99 > 2s for /v1/chat/completions (per-model)"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/chat-p99"
```
Aisha K.: plus gate it with a volume check in the alerting system: min_sample_rate: 0.5 (meaning >50rps).
Miguel: for Prometheus sharded metrics, translate to per-shard query; ops will handle.
Ken: dashboard suggestions: add panel 'p99 by model (5m, top-10 routes)' and 'p99 delta vs 1h median'. Can use the existing trace-annotator to correlate deploys/canaries.
Lara: runbook update: include steps to quickly identify canary routing changes and rollback commands. add CLI snippet for rollback: `rictl route update --service chat --split legacy=0.9,canary=0.1`
Priya: also add a mitigation pattern: 'fallback-for-heavy-customers' — scripted traffic-shift that support can trigger to reduce customer impact. attach permissions notes.
Aisha K.: post-incident actions (TL;DR): 1) change alert thresholds and gating (p99 >2s & vol>50rps & 5m) 2) create per-model/per-route p99 alerts 3) add traffic-weighted p99 panels + delta vs 1h median 4) runbook add canary rollback + fallback script 5) infra item: investigate image-pull concurrency and node disk IO.
Miguel: timeline note for postmortem: initial spike at 2389007700, canary rollout ~2389007200, mitigation started 2389007800, revert completed 2389008400.
ops-sre: creating alert-PR and dashboard ticket, will request review from eng-platform and eng-sre.
Lara: support followup: customers notified, SLA impacts logged, CS will follow up tomorrow.
Aisha K.: thanks everyone. leaving notes in incident channel and marking this thread for post-incident review. :thumbsup:
Priya: reassigning follow-ups: @Ken infra item, @Miguel alert rule PR, @Lara customer comms, @Aisha postmortem lead.
oncall-bot: incident closed (notes added), duration ~12m, paging escalations avoided after revert.
Aisha K.: ending handoff. good job all.
